description: TypeLoop release operations stay behind feature branches, pull requests, and human approval.

hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = (& git rev-parse --show-toplevel); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & py -3 (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/pre_tool_use_policy.py')"
